method: Read-only source and copy audit, direct viewing of image assets, static CSS detector, existing isolated behavioral suites. No site mutation or browser rendering.
limits: Current desktop/mobile rendered composition unavailable under prior security restriction
No live form submission or store installation
No fresh native app runtime test; product claims compared with existing source evidence and owner decisions
English/Azerbaijani key coverage checked; native-speaker editorial acceptance not established
integrityVerdict: Coherent product-specific structure in source; final visual acceptance pending

scores.reason: Do not manufacture aggregate or WCAG/responsive acceptance without rendered evidence.

findings.issue: Plan selection, saved results and continuing from the current step repeat across program copy, preview routes, training scenarios and progress. This weakens forward movement.
findings.recommendation: Keep each feature, reduce duplicate explanations. Programs explain selection/author/content; training explains action; progress explains return/history/achievements.

findings.issue: Six settings/profile/invite explanations plus a theme preview occupy a full chapter before FAQ and download. Secondary features compete with the central reason to install.
findings.recommendation: Retain all six capabilities, compress profile/language/invite copy, give privacy and control the main emphasis. Do not add more decorations.

findings.issue: Internal or vague wording: подтвердите связь, текущий шаг, доступные рейтинги, с учётом роли аккаунта; redundant подходящий вам подход.
findings.recommendation: Use everyday terms while preserving scope: подтвердите друг друга как партнёров; продолжайте с того занятия, где остановились; инструменты зависят от выбранной роли; выберите подходящую программу. Confirm ranking criterion before naming it more specifically.

findings.issue: Programs/clients/schedule repeated in hero, diagram, audience copy and closing, while the middle explains registration and client reassurance more than daily professional work.
findings.recommendation: Replace repetition with one concise sourced workflow of creating a program, working with clients and planning meetings; no invented revenue or engagement guarantees.

findings.issue: The label promises instructions but lands at the closing store section.
findings.recommendation: Rename to Скачать or point to the actual getting-started FAQ; keep one stable meaning for the control.

findings.issue: Non-home footer focus ring #89651d on #202822 has calculated contrast 2.84:1. The home footer already overrides it to a light gold.
findings.recommendation: Apply a shared light footer focus color across page types. This is a source-color calculation, not a full WCAG audit.

findings.issue: Unused legacy layout rules and append-only contradictory historical documentation increase maintenance risk. Detector reports many token-document discrepancies; these are not independently proven visual defects.
findings.recommendation: Remove only verified unused rules in a separate bounded cleanup and leave one clearly current documentation summary.

releaseDependencies.item: Authorized generic store destinations cannot complete installation. Replace with real listings and update release copy when released; do not invent an access gate.
Rendered desktop/mobile, keyboard and enlarged-text review remains required; source tests cannot establish geometry or smoothness.
Public legal links previously returned Cloudflare 1010 to automation. Origin document availability/approval unverified, not a proven missing document.
No connected store-click analytics destination; conversion improvement cannot be claimed.

positive: Four page types suffice; no extra pages needed
Strong distinction between community, program choice and actual training
Realistic imagery supports existing topics without returning rejected cartoons
No fabricated reviews, user counts, subscription claims or access gate
Responsive WebP/lazy images and local font; small runtime scripts
Native FAQ and radios, keyboard program tabs, reduced-motion handling
Contact preserves drafts and handles network/malformed/timeout/duplicate states

detectorInterpretation.advisories: 177 typography,9 radius,49 color documentation mismatches; not 235 independently verified UI defects
detectorInterpretation.primaryContext: Small bounded contact feedback height/margin/padding transitions inside @supports; no measured jank or evidence of a release-blocking performance defect

overallRecommendation: Keep current visual identity, approved hero and chapter order. Focus the final edit on repetition, plain language, professional benefit, navigation label and shared footer focus. No new blocks/pages/imagery required.

followThrough.releaseDependencies: Remain explicitly pending; no real store listing, legal approval, analytics destination or rendered acceptance fabricated
